press_references.value: Emirates NBD launches first-of-its-kind Visa personalised card art experience in the UAE

partnership_announcements.description: Emirates NBD and Visa have formed a new partnership to deliver a personalised Visa card art experience in the UAE, combining Visa’s tokenisation and digital credential capabilities with Emirates NBD’s ENBD X mobile banking app.

press_references.value: Emirates NBD joins forces with Zoud to champion financial literacy and empower youth at Global Money Week UAE 2026

partnership_announcements.description: Emirates NBD and Zoud formed a flagship partnership for Global Money Week UAE 2026, with the bank acting as Flagship Partner and Gold Sponsor to support youth-focused financial literacy initiatives.

press_references.value: Emirates NBD and Sobha Realty partner to offer integrated home financing solutions for off-plan projects in Dubai

partnership_announcements.description: Emirates NBD and Sobha Realty have formed a strategic partnership to embed Emirates NBD’s structured mortgage solutions into Sobha’s off-plan residential sales journey across Dubai, providing integrated home financing with early-stage financing clarity and streamlined approvals for buyers.

press_references.value: Dubai boosts competitiveness of free zones through trilateral partnership

partnership_announcements.description: Emirates NBD signed an MoU with the Economic Security Centre of Dubai and the Dubai Free Zones Council to form a strategic partnership aimed at speeding up bank account opening for investors in Dubai’s free zones and enhancing compliance via digital solutions and data sharing.

press_references.value: Emirates NBD delivered a record AED 29.8bln profit before tax, up 10%

partnership_announcements.description: Emirates NBD launched new co-branded cards in partnership with Emaar, Aldar, Majid Al Futtaim and Amazon to enhance its retail card offering.

press_references.value: Emirates NBD launches Voyager Mastercard Credit Card, delivering complete travel ecosystem for cardholders

partnership_announcements.description: Emirates NBD and Mastercard announced a new collaboration to issue the Emirates NBD Voyager Mastercard credit card, combining Mastercard’s payment technology with Emirates NBD’s travel-focused banking services.

press_references.value: Emirates NBD Partners with Letswork to Pilot Flexible Workspace Access

partnership_announcements.description: Emirates NBD partnered with coworking platform Letswork to run a 12‑month pilot giving selected bank employees on‑demand access to 4,000+ desks, meeting rooms, and offices across the UAE and abroad, with potential expansion.

press_references.value: Emirates NBD signs MoU with Fidelity International

partnership_announcements.description: Emirates NBD signed a Memorandum of Understanding with Fidelity International to co-develop a workplace savings proposition for UAE employers, combining Emirates NBD’s local banking and asset management capabilities with Fidelity’s global retirement and investment expertise.

press_references.value: Emirates NBD Goes Live on Partior for Real-Time Blockchain Payments

product_launches.description: Emirates NBD launched a real-time US dollar cross-border payments service for corporate and institutional clients using the Partior blockchain network, initially enabling instant payments to J.P. Morgan beneficiary accounts.

press_references.value: ZAWYA: Emirates NBD elevates digital banking experience with launch of Rewards Hub on ENBD X

product_launches.description: Emirates NBD launched the Rewards Hub, a unified digital rewards and lifestyle marketplace integrated into its ENBD X banking app, offering flights, hotels, Apple Store shopping, lifestyle experiences, gift cards, cashback, and flexible payment options.

press_references.value: International Securities is the first broker to go live on Emirates NBD Pay using Visa’s AFT model

product_launches.description: Emirates NBD launched Emirates NBD Pay with Visa’s Account Funding Transaction model for brokerage funding and onboarded International Securities as the first live broker, enabling near real-time card-to-account top-ups for trading accounts.

press_references.value: ZAWYA-PRESSR: Emirates NBD expands precious metals offering with branded silver bars

product_launches.description: Emirates NBD launched Emirates NBD-branded physical silver bars in various denominations, expanding its precious metals investment products for retail and high-net-worth clients.

press_references.value: Emirates NBD issues Dh1 billion first-ever digital bond in MENA

product_launches.description: Emirates NBD launched a Dh1 billion, three-year fixed-rate Digitally Native Notes digital bond, the first AED-denominated digital bond and largest public digital bond in MENA, listed on Nasdaq Dubai and issued via Euroclear’s D-FMI platform.

press_references.value: Emirates NBD pioneers first branded gold bar ‘Emirates NBD Gold’ in the UAE

product_launches.description: Emirates NBD launched ‘Emirates NBD Gold’, the UAE’s first bank-branded gold bar investment product, available via redeemable gold certificates in multiple gram denominations.

press_references.value: Emirates NBD and U by Emaar mark seven years of award-winning partnership and industry leadership

product_launches.description: Emirates NBD, in partnership with U by Emaar, announced a new metal, co-branded Emirati U By Emaar Infinite credit card for UAE Nationals, offering tiered benefits, up to 15% back on Emaar spends for the first three months, Platinum status and other lifestyle perks.
